json_schema.description: One model-constructed, executable authoring input example.
json_schema.title: PlaybillAuthoringExampleResult

json_schema.description:
One resolved coverage answer: the whole `playbill-coverage-result-v1`.

``result`` carries the frozen coverage grammar verbatim -- span results,
cards, the one batch summary, coverage health, accepted coordinate, scope,
manifest epoch, and the index/overlay/manifest digests the answer was
resolved against. Resolving coverage appends no receipt: it changes no
accepted state, and those three digests are what make it reproducible.
json_schema.title: PlaybillCoverageResult

json_schema.description:
The deterministic greppable floor as base64 bytes keyed by floor path.

``manifest`` is the decoded root ``manifest.json``: it binds every file to
the accepted coordinate it was projected from. The service is
filesystem-free, so materializing the directory is the client's act.
json_schema.title: PlaybillFloorExport

json_schema.description: Client-owned truth about the optional workspace floor refresh.
json_schema.title: PlaybillFloorRefreshResult

json_schema.description:
One executed query: its replayable result beside its execution receipt.

``receipt`` carries the whole ``playbill-query-execution-receipt-v1``; its
``result_digest`` is the receipt's content identity, and
``journal_record_digest`` is present only when the caller owned a journal.
json_schema.title: PlaybillQueryRun

PlaybillFloorRefreshResult.description: Client-owned truth about the optional workspace floor refresh.
PlaybillFloorRefreshResult.title: PlaybillFloorRefreshResult

json_schema.description: Activation receipt plus the independent client-workspace refresh outcome.
json_schema.title: PlaybillWorkspaceActivationResult

json_schema.description: Freshness of the configured local floor against a daemon coordinate.
json_schema.title: PlaybillWorkspaceFloorStatus

json_schema.description: A verified floor export materialized by a client-side adapter.
json_schema.title: PlaybillWorkspaceFloorWriteResult
